concerns.text: The `Statistical Result` entity defined in `data-model.md` (fields: test_type, parameters, statistics, interpretation) does not match any of the JSON‑Schema contracts provided (`statistics-result.schema.yaml` and `statistics_result.schema.yaml`), which define only `cutoff`, `spike_point`, and `slope_change`. This creates a cross‑document inconsistency: the plan and data‑model expect a richer statistical result structure, but the contracts enforce a different, narrower schema. Align the data‑model definition with the contract schema (or add a matching contract) and update the plan to reference the correct schema file.
